top_signals.title: Wheat Futures Climb for Second Day as Black Sea Exports Falter
top_signals.summary: Wheat futures rose for a second session as escalating attacks between Russia and Ukraine threaten export prospects from two of the world’s top suppliers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Apple tops $5tn valuation for first time
top_signals.summary: Tech giant gains due to its lack of huge spending on AI and as investors seek havens from sell-off in chip sector
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Galaxy Digital buys 500 acres in McGregor for second Texas AI data center campus
top_signals.summary: The “privately funded" Texas campus is expected to generate a minimum of $130 million for McGregor's local tax base, Galaxy said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
